products.folded: 87 × 58.5 × 30 cm (L × W × H), manufacturer’s most-compact configuration; test the actual fold in your boot.
products.tyres: Air-filled; front wheel swivels and locks.
products.newborn: UK page permits lie-flat seat from birth; Cot S plus Avi Spin Cot S adapters is the manufacturer’s preferred early-month option.
products.running: US guidance says at least 9 months and sitting unaided, with the front wheel locked. This is not confirmation of UK/PT permission: follow the supplied regional manual; no running with newborn attachments.
products.warranty: Claims through original retailer; CYBEX says full conditions are in the manual.
products.terrain: Pneumatic tyres, suspension and lockable front wheel suit mixed walking surfaces; performance is not independently ranked here.
products.tradeoff: 68.5 cm published open width; pumping and puncture repairs add upkeep. UK standard box omits adapters.
products.name: Avi Spin
products.summary: All-terrain three-wheeler with a lie-flat seat and a confirmed Cot S travel-system route.

products.folded: 88 × 58 × 31 cm (L × W × H), published figure; check wheel-removal configuration in supplied instructions.
products.tyres: 16-inch air-filled rear wheels; lockable swivel front wheel.
products.suspension: Suspension stated on the manufacturer page.
products.newborn: Thule bassinet or approved infant car-seat adapter, sold separately.
products.running: UK/EU running approval unresolved here. Obtain the current regional safety manual and written Thule guidance before treating this as a running purchase; newborn attachments are for walking.
products.warranty: UK page: 2-year Thule Guarantee; strollers eligible for +1 year extended warranty on registration, subject to terms.
products.terrain: Large pneumatic wheels, suspension and twist hand brake support mixed-surface walking.
products.tradeoff: 69 cm door-pass-through figure and 88 cm folded length merit a doorway/boot trial. Extra newborn hardware required.
products.name: Urban Glide 3
products.summary: Lightest published weight of these four reference configurations; large air-filled wheels and a hand brake.

products.variant: Standard V6 single; not V6 Plus
products.folded: 81 × 61 × 44 cm (L × W × H), wheels on, bumper bar off; 81 × 47 × 33 cm wheels off.
products.tyres: Three 12-inch air-filled tyres; lockable swivel front.
products.newborn: Manufacturer lists newborn suitability; Single Carrycot and approved car-seat adapters are optional.
products.running: FAQ permits jogging on even terrain from 6 months. Standard V6 is not running-certified; manufacturer directs regular running or bumpier terrain to V6 Plus/Sport.
products.warranty: 2-year manufacturer warranty stated on UK product page.
products.tradeoff: No handlebar brake on standard V6; V6 Plus specifications and running certification must not be transferred to it.
products.name: Nipper V6
products.summary: Everyday all-terrain option with three equal-size pneumatic wheels; distinguish it carefully from V6 Plus.

products.variant: TER_V3 official reference; confirm regional generation before ordering
products.folded: 93 × 63 × 33 cm with 12-inch wheels; 93 × 63 × 39 cm with 16-inch wheels (L × W × H).
products.newborn: Full-recline sling seat from birth; optional cocoon or carrycot plus; approved car-seat adapter route.
products.running: Conflict: product page markets a jogger, but its linked shared manual warns against running/skating. Resolve the exact generation and regional manual with Mountain Buggy before running.
products.warranty: UK support: 12 months, extended to 3 years if registered within one month; direct website purchases automatically registered. Verify regional terms.
products.terrain: Rear-wheel choice and hand brake are useful features to assess for rough walking and gradients.
products.tradeoff: Heaviest of these four published reference weights and longest listed fold; retailer V4 listings must not inherit TER_V3 specs automatically.
products.name: terrain
products.summary: Two rear-wheel sizes, rear suspension and an active hand brake provide adaptable mixed-surface equipment.

products.variant: Exact Cot S name required; confirm UK/PT model code
products.newborn: Birth to approximately 6 months / 9 kg, subject to the supplied regional instructions.
products.tradeoff: Do not substitute Cot S Lux because its name is similar. Canadian page corroborates compatibility only; regional codes and availability need checking.
products.name: Cot S
products.summary: Carrycot explicitly named for Avi Spin; use the dedicated Cot S adapters.

products.variant: Balios/Talos generation-specific model; excluded from confirmed Avi configuration
products.newborn: Birth to approximately 6 months, up to 9 kg.
products.tradeoff: Do not buy for Avi Spin without explicit manufacturer confirmation for the exact codes.
products.name: Cot S Lux
products.summary: Manufacturer names Balios S Lux and Talos S Lux compatibility; Avi Spin fit is not established.

products.variant: Comfort / Plus fabric varies by listing
products.newborn: 45–87 cm, maximum 13 kg; included newborn inlay and manual govern fit.
products.running: Gentle walking only on stroller; never run with infant seat attached.
products.tradeoff: ADAC 1.7 belongs to Cloud T + Base T tested in 2023; it cannot be assigned to Cloud T + Base Z2 or another seat.
products.name: Cloud T i-Size
products.summary: Infant car seat approved with Base T or Base Z2; compatible with Avi Spin through its car-seat adapters.

products.tradeoff: Check the exact vehicle seating position and CYBEX vehicle guidance before ordering.

products.running: Gentle walking pace only when infant seat is attached.
products.tradeoff: Separate from the carrycot adapter; confirm exact regional listing.

evidence.title: Avi Spin UK specifications
evidence.claim: UK weight, most-compact fold, pneumatic wheels and suspension support the comparison fields.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Avi Spin UK newborn and travel-system guidance
evidence.claim: UK page names Cot S and CYBEX infant seats; adapters are separate.
evidence.limitations: UK newborn seat guidance differs from US. Cot S Lux is not named.

evidence.title: Avi Spin running restrictions
evidence.claim: Manufacturer FAQ requires at least 9 months, unaided sitting, locked wheel and upright seat; excludes running with carrycot/car seat.
evidence.limitations: US FAQ supplies explicit restrictions; follow the supplied UK/PT manual and developmental guidance. Never infer newborn running suitability from from-birth walking approval.

evidence.title: Avi Spin warranty route
evidence.claim: Original retailer handles warranty claims; complete conditions are in user manual.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Avi Spin Cot S Adapter official compatibility
evidence.claim: UK manufacturer page explicitly pairs Avi Spin and Cot S; code 524000795.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Avi/Avi Spin car-seat adapter
evidence.claim: Adapter 520004225 accepts CYBEX infant car seats on Avi/Spin; gentle walking only.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Cot adapter regional code discrepancy
evidence.claim: UK official code is 524000795; some retailer listings use 524000796.
evidence.limitations: Retailer corroboration only; confirm code and regional pack with seller. Do not infer different fit from the code alone.

evidence.title: Cot S named for Avi Spin
evidence.claim: Official Canadian Cot S page confirms Avi Spin pairing and walking-only use.
evidence.limitations: Canadian reference; exact UK/PT code and limits must come from supplied local manual. Page lists approximately six months / 20 lb.

evidence.title: Cot S Lux manufacturer compatibility list
evidence.claim: Manufacturer lists Balios S Lux and Talos S Lux, not Avi Spin.
evidence.limitations: Absence is not a physical impossibility test. There is insufficient manufacturer evidence to approve Lux for Avi; choose the explicitly listed Cot S.

evidence.title: Urban Glide 3 UK specifications
evidence.claim: 11.9 kg and published 88 × 58 × 31 cm fold; pneumatic rear wheels, suspension and hand brake.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Urban Glide 3 UK newborn route
evidence.claim: Manufacturer approves birth use with Thule bassinet or infant car-seat adapter, sold separately.
evidence.limitations: This does not approve every car seat. Confirm exact adapter and seat list; do not assume Cloud T compatibility.

evidence.title: Urban Glide 3 regional running instructions require verification
evidence.claim: Current UK sales page establishes all-terrain use but does not resolve exact regional running restrictions.
evidence.limitations: Exact current UK/PT safety booklet not obtained. Do not equate six-month stroller-seat guidance or a jogging category URL with permission to run. Seek written manufacturer guidance.

evidence.title: Thule UK guarantee and extended warranty
evidence.claim: 2 years plus 1 year extended warranty for registered strollers, subject to terms.
evidence.limitations: UK page; manufacturer warranty is separate from statutory rights. Extension excludes normal wear.

evidence.title: Nipper V6 UK specifications
evidence.claim: 12.25 kg; wheels-on/off folds and 12-inch tyres verified. UK page states two-year manufacturer warranty.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Standard V6 jogging versus V6 Plus certification
evidence.claim: FAQ permits even-terrain jogging from six months; comparison gives standard V6 no running certification and Plus yes.
evidence.limitations: Standard V6 and V6 Plus are distinct. Do not transfer Plus handbrake, 14-inch wheels or certification.

evidence.title: Nipper V6 newborn and adapter route
evidence.claim: Manufacturer names Single Carrycot and optional approved car-seat adapters.
evidence.limitations: No exact Cloud T approval was established in this review.

evidence.title: Terrain TER_V3 specifications
evidence.claim: Official reference lists 13.5 kg, two rear-wheel sizes and separate folded heights.
evidence.limitations: Reference is TER_V3. Some UK retailers name V4; verify the exact generation before transferring dimensions or weight. Fold axis order has been normalized to L×W×H.

evidence.title: Terrain newborn and travel-system configurations
evidence.claim: Manufacturer provides full recline plus optional carrycot/cocoon and adapter routes.
evidence.limitations: Exact car-seat pairings require the current regional adapter compatibility list; Cloud T fit is not established here.

evidence.title: Terrain linked manual warning conflicts with marketing
evidence.claim: Page markets running, while linked manual warns this product is not suitable for running or skating.
evidence.limitations: Shared platform manual dated 2020, English warning printed pp29–30. Establish applicable generation/market and obtain updated written guidance before running.

evidence.title: Mountain Buggy UK registration warranty
evidence.claim: UK support states one-year standard warranty; registration within one month adds two years.
evidence.limitations: UK manufacturer-owned support page; direct website purchases automatically registered. Regional terms and proof of purchase still matter.

evidence.title: Cloud T i-Size official approved bases
evidence.claim: Manufacturer lists Base T and Base Z2; 45–87 cm, maximum 13 kg and 4.5 kg seat.
evidence.limitations: Vehicle seating-position approval must also be checked. Comfort/Plus fabric options do not change the named seat to another model.

evidence.title: Base T manufacturer compatibility
evidence.claim: Cloud T i-Size explicitly listed; official Black code 522000069.
evidence.limitations: Manufacturer page reviewed; this is not a live stock or price confirmation.

evidence.title: Base Z2 manufacturer compatibility
evidence.claim: Cloud T i-Size explicitly listed; official Black code 522002443.
evidence.limitations: Compatibility does not imply the same independently tested rating as Base T.

evidence.title: ADAC published child-seat results
evidence.claim: ADAC table records Cloud T + Base T, test year 2023, overall 1.7. Cloud T without base is a separate 2.1 result.
evidence.limitations: Combination-specific historical test. Do not transfer 1.7 to Base Z2, Cloud G, Cloud Z2 or untested configurations; lower ADAC numbers are better, not a universal safety score.

evidence.title: Moss Green AVI Spin — UK manufacturer code
evidence.claim: CYBEX UK identifies the Moss Green AVI Spin as product code 525000441. The UK retailer lists the same code.
evidence.limitations: The manufacturer does not explain whether the UK and Portuguese product codes reflect packaging, market specification or another difference.

evidence.title: Moss Green AVI Spin — Portuguese manufacturer code
evidence.claim: CYBEX Portugal identifies the Moss Green AVI Spin as product code 525000437. Both country pages list the AVI Spin with the same published weight and folded dimensions.
evidence.limitations: The manufacturer does not establish that the two regional products are identical in every detail or that either code is an older model.
